1: A RESOLUTION PURSUANT TO SECTION 4.11 OF THE TOWN CHARTER OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, TO SET THE SALARIES FOR EACH MEMBER OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION
7:
WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, is authorized by Town Charter Section 4.11, to enact a Resolution setting the salary for the Planning Commission of the Town of Clermont, Georgia; and

WHEREAS, the proper administration of the Clermont Zoning Procedures necessitates a sacrifice of time and effort, for which, the Planning Commission Members should be partially compensated;

NOW, THEREFORE, be it resolved by the Town Council of the Town of Clermont,

Georgia, and it is hereby resolved by the authority of same, as follows:
9:
Pursuant to Section 4.11 of the Town Charter, a salary for each Member of the Planning Commission is established as follows:

Planning Commission Compensation and Expenses. Each Member of the Planning Commission shall receive compensation of $25.00 per meeting attended, and reimbursement for expenses actually and necessarily incurred by them in carrying out their official duties.
10: The Resolution is hereby adopted and effective upon passage, with the salary to become effective for the next Planning Commission meeting following passage, the public health, safety, and general welfare demanding it.
11:
All resolutions that are in conflict with this Resolution, are repealed to the extent of the conflict.
